_note: Tutorial tips (first-run onboarding). Each id is shown once (GameState.tutorial_done) while Settings > Tutorial tips is on. pages = consecutive cards. Triggers live in code (main/camp/delve/combat screens); see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

pages.title: Welcome to SPD Tactics
pages.text: The surface Camp is your home. From here your heroes delve into the dungeon, fight tactical battles, and bring loot back to grow the Camp.

pages.title: The loop
pages.text:
1. Pack supplies and pick a hero (Delve tab).
2. The Delve Bar explores for you; encounters pop up as cards.
3. Fights play out on an 8x8 grid where you control every move.
4. Extract at a boss campfire (or with a Scroll of Passage) to bank your loot.

pages.title: Death has a price
pages.text: If your hero falls, the unbanked pack is lost, gear cracks (repair it at the Forge) and the hero drops back to Lv1. Your Camp, stash and facilities are permanent.

camp_delve.title: Packing for a delve
camp_delve.text: Torches keep the light on - in darkness you fight with no Barrier. Rations stop starvation. Potions heal mid-fight. Unused supplies come back to the stash.

camp_forge.title: The Forge
camp_forge.text: Spend Iron Ore and gold to forge better weapons and armor, upgrade them, and repair gear that cracked when a hero died. Higher tiers need more Strength.

camp_journal.title: The Journal
camp_journal.text: Milestones give one-time rewards for things you'll do anyway. The Codex fills in as you meet monsters, traps and items.

delve_bar.title: The Delve Bar
delve_bar.text: Your hero explores on their own. Watch the torch and satiety - they drain as you go and spare torches/rations are used automatically. Pause or speed up below.

pages.title: Your first fight
pages.text: Tap a tile next to your hero to move, or tap an adjacent enemy to attack. Every hit lands for fixed damage - no dice. Enemies act on a clock: fast ones act twice per tick.

pages.title: Barrier and armor
pages.text: The blue part of your HP bar is Barrier: it soaks damage first and refills every fight. Each segment is one enemy hit it can stop. Armor's DR subtracts from every physical hit. Use Hint if you're stuck, or Auto to let the game play.

surprise.title: Surprise attack!
surprise.text: Step through a doorway so it closes behind you, or circle a tall-grass tile so the foe loses sight of you. Your next hit is a Surprise: x1.5 damage (Assassin x2.5) that never misses, then enemy armor still applies. Stealth blades and Assassins also pierce 50% of that armor. Snakes slip melee hits that are not a Surprise, but magic always hits them and bows hit after the first shot.

telegraph.title: Red tiles = danger
telegraph.text: A red tile shows exactly where an attack will land and when. Step off it before it resolves. Bosses telegraph their big moves too.

trap.title: Traps
trap.text: That icon is a trap. Stepping on it fires it once. Monsters know where traps are and avoid them - but you can shove or knock them in. Use Search to reveal hidden ones.

boss.title: Boss fight
boss.text: Bosses have big telegraphed attacks. Don't get cornered, step off red tiles, and drink a potion before you drop too low.

door.title: Door Choice
door.text: Two doors, two risks. Read the clues: a fight with a reward, a locked chest, or a quiet room. You can also ignore both.

special.title: Special room
special.text: Special rooms trade supplies, HP or time for rewards. Greyed-out options show what you're missing.

floor_done.title: Floor cleared
floor_done.text: Descending heals a little. You can also spend torch to search for a hidden door with a secret cache - Rogues always find it.

campfire.title: Campfire
campfire.text: The boss is down. Extract to bank everything, or push deeper with an unbanked pack for bigger rewards.

after_death.title: Back at Camp
after_death.text: Your hero fell: the pack was lost and their gear cracked. Repair it at the Forge (Blacksmith), then try again - the Camp keeps everything you banked.

after_extract.title: Loot banked
after_extract.text: Everything you carried is safe in the stash. Spend it on facility upgrades and gear, and check the Journal for milestone rewards.
